CREATE TABLE "public"."EvolvProfile" (
  "ageRange" text NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "country" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "curiositySkills" text[] NOT NULL,
  "focusAreas" text[] NOT NULL,
  "focusSubAreas" text[] NOT NULL,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "profileCompleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "profilePhoto" text,
  "roles" text[] NOT NULL,
  "skillsCanDo" text[] NOT NULL,
  "skillsLearning" text[] NOT NULL,
  "skillsToImprove" text[] NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  "workingToward" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "EvolvProfile_ageRange_check_e9d011da" CHECK ("ageRange" IN ('UNDER_18', 'AGE_18_24', 'AGE_25_34', 'AGE_35_44', 'AGE_45_PLUS')),
  CONSTRAINT "EvolvProfile_curiositySkills_elem_not_null_64d06193" CHECK (array_position("curiositySkills", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "EvolvProfile_focusAreas_elem_not_null_222c8e05" CHECK (array_position("focusAreas", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "EvolvProfile_focusSubAreas_elem_not_null_c824ac98" CHECK (array_position("focusSubAreas", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "EvolvProfile_roles_elem_not_null_37524d49" CHECK (array_position("roles", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "EvolvProfile_skillsCanDo_elem_not_null_950c80fb" CHECK (array_position("skillsCanDo", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "EvolvProfile_skillsLearning_elem_not_null_cf15a663" CHECK (array_position("skillsLearning", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "EvolvProfile_skillsToImprove_elem_not_null_96353631" CHECK (array_position("skillsToImprove", NULL) IS NULL)
)
